The 'training' variable is mapped to 'other' as it is a complex behavioral intervention rather than a specific chemical, genetic, or ligand-based perturbation defined in the ontology. Fibre type is mapped to differentiation_state_comparison as it represents distinct mature muscle cell lineages.
